from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDoc(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentDoc]
